mapper.select: select ID as orgId,NAME as orgName from SYS_ORG
select ID as orgId,NAME as orgName from SYS_ORG where ID = #{orgId}
select ID as orgId,NAME as orgName from SYS_ORG where DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and NAME like CONCAT('%',#{orgName},'%')

select id as orgId,NAME as orgName,PARENT_ID as parentId,DIRECTOR_ID as directorId from SYS_ORG where DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and CATEGORY = 'DEPT' and PARENT_ID in (select ID FROM SYS_ORG where PARENT_ID in (select ID FROM SYS_ORG where PARENT_ID = '0'))
